mapper.insert:
insert into daily_market_data (stock_code, trade_date, pe, pb, pct_chg, ev, mkt_cap_float, total_shares, share_issuing_mkt, maxup, maxdown, chg, vwap, volume, amt, turn, vol_ratio, high, low, open, close, pre_close, adjfactor, create_time, update_time) values
(#{item.stockCode}, #{item.tradeDate}, #{item.pe}, #{item.pb}, #{item.pctChg}, #{item.ev}, #{item.mktCapFloat}, #{item.totalShares}, #{item.shareIssuingMkt}, #{item.maxup}, #{item.maxdown}, #{item.chg}, #{item.vwap}, #{item.volume}, #{item.amt}, #{item.turn}, #{item.volRatio}, #{item.high}, #{item.low}, #{item.open}, #{item.close}, #{item.preClose}, #{item.adjfactor}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime})
on duplicate key update pe = values(pe), pb = values(pb), pct_chg = values(pct_chg), ev = values(ev), mkt_cap_float = values(mkt_cap_float), total_shares = values(total_shares), share_issuing_mkt = values(share_issuing_mkt), maxup = values(maxup), maxdown = values(maxdown), chg = values(chg), vwap = values(vwap), volume = values(volume), amt = values(amt), turn = values(turn), vol_ratio = values(vol_ratio), high = values(high), low = values(low), open = values(open), close = values(close), pre_close = values(pre_close), adjfactor = values(adjfactor), update_time = values(update_time)
mapper.select: SELECT trade_date, stock_code, pe, pb, pct_chg, ev, mkt_cap_float, total_shares, share_issuing_mkt, chg, vwap, volume, amt, turn, vol_ratio, high, low, open, close, pre_close, adjfactor FROM daily_market_data WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} AND trade_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY trade_date ASC
